 Volunteers asked to help search for missing child 
 Roman Heilman, 6, was reported missing in Louisa, Kentucky. (Source: WSAZ) By WSAZ News Staff Published : Nov. 1, 2026 at 8:52 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LAWRENCE COUNTY, Ky. (WSAZ) - Volunteers are being asked to join the search for a missing child Monday morning, according to the Lawrence County Emergency Management officials.
 A staging area will be set up at Richardson Missionary on Highway 1690, directly across from the old Hinkle Store.
 Volunteers are asked to meet at 8 a.m.
 ----------------------------------------
 LAWRENCE COUNTY, Ky. (WSAZ) - Law enforcement is looking for a missing 6-year-old boy that could potentially be in danger, and is asking for help. 
 Roman Heilman was reported missing in Louisa, Kentucky by state police. He’s described as weighing 60 pounds, having blonde hair and blue eyes. He was last seen wearing a green fur jacket, red and white monster pajama pants, and crocs. 
 He was last seen at 3:45 p.m. on November 1 at 948 Tadpole Road. According to the Lawrence County Emergency Management’s Facebook post, the missing child is known to respond to the song “If you’re happy and you know it.” 
 If you see the missing child or have any information, Lawrence County Emergency Management says to call 911 immediately.
